Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters, sort order, and grouping each time you open a project, this feature removes that repetition entirely. Configure a list exactly the way you want it—filtered by assignee, sorted by due date, grouped by status—and save it as a view you can return to with a single click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can build dedicated setups for sprints, client work, personal priorities, or anything else your workflow demands. Views aren't limited to your own screen, either: any saved view can be shared with your team, giving everyone the same lens on a project without asking someone to recreate your setup from scratch.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no additional cost, and it works across every list in your workspace starting now. Whether you manage one project or fifty, this is a small change that saves real time every day.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
